escalation_policy: Use a stronger model only after one failed attempt on a medium/high-risk task, and record the reason in the usage ledger.
notes: Subscription usage (Claude Code plan) and metered API usage are tracked separately. Only the 'api' kind counts toward monthly_limit_usd.
Subscription usage is recorded as message/turn estimates, for awareness only.
No polling loops and no autonomous dispatch. dispatch_mode 'live' needs explicit human approval and a confirmed invocation method.
